reader.requirement: At 1985 the RECORD KEY clause's data-name-1 may be written qualified by group, record and file-name qualifiers, must identify one item uniquely and must lie in a record of the file.

edition-consulted.switches: Year == 2002 admits subscripted file-clause operands (FileControlBinder.Resolve ScreenClauseOperandOccurrence); false at 85 and 2023
the SOURCE phrase (record-key-name) is a 2002+ construct, refused at 85 with COBOL0900

reader.edition-search: as for the ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause: one KeyOf/InRecords resolution in ResolveFiles serves both clauses at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness qualifies the prime key in a passing program; not exercised are the file-name qualifier, an ambiguous unqualified name, a qualifier reaching a WS item, and a misqualified name

probes.expected: RECORD KEY IS K-ID OF IX-REC IN IXF (record and file-name qualifiers) accepted; START KEY > K-ID IN IX-REC IN IXF ('0002') reads 0003

probes.printed: error COBOL1639: RECORD KEY 'K-ID' does not uniquely identify a data item — 2 declarations match
probes.expected: K-ID declared in IX-REC and WS-K: must be qualified

probes.printed: error COBOL0863: RECORD KEY 'K-ID' references an item outside this file's record descriptions ... (ANSI §1985:IX.2.7.3 SR2)
probes.expected: K-ID OF WS-K: not in the file's records, refused

probes.printed: error COBOL0863: RECORD KEY 'K-ID' references nothing described in this program ...
probes.expected: K-ID OF K-AREA: K-AREA is no superordinate of K-ID, refused

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.2.7.3 SR1  (2.7.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1
OK  §1985:IX.2.7.3 SR2  (2.7.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2

reader.notes: Same resolution as the alternate key. The misqualified operand's message says 'references nothing described in this program' rather than naming the qualifier that failed; the verdict (refusal) is right.

(ANSI §1985:IX.2.7.3 SR2)'), while the same clause under IX2 is accepted. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:IX.2.7.3 SR1', 'OK  §1985:IX.2.7.3 SR2'.
